item.text:
**Verdict:** No. In 2024 I found only procedural formality, not real respect for term limits or orderly succession. The dominant evidence points to stronger Party control over state institutions and no visible successor/transfer constraint.

| Valence | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Weak positive / procedural | **Presidium elected, agenda set for China's annual legislative session** | Xinhua | 2024-03-04 | https://english.news.cn/20240304/c7ae314c2c8b42d297f49f840e2ba916/c.html | The NPC session still followed formal procedure: deputies elected a presidium and set the agenda. This shows institutional choreography continued, but it does not show any genuine succession constraint or term-limit respect. | 4B.8 |
| Strong negative | **China passes law granting Communist Party more control over cabinet** | Reuters | 2024-03-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891 | Reuters said the amended State Council Organic Law effectively gave the Party more executive control over the cabinet and stressed Party central leadership. That is evidence of Party capture, not constitutional transfer of power. | 4B.8, 4B.4, 4B.5 |
| Strong negative | **China ends 30-year tradition: premier's annual press conference** | Reuters | 2024-03-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/china-cancels-premiers-press-conference-for-first-time-since-1993-3322647 | Reuters reported that Li Qiang’s annual press conference was canceled for 2024 and future years, removing one of the few public venues for cabinet accountability. This is more centralization, not succession discipline. | 4B.8, 4B.6, 4B.4 |
| Strong negative | **China’s Xi grooms next-generation party leaders, but no anointed heir yet** | The Straits Times | 2024-03-03 | https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/china-s-xi-grooms-next-generation-party-leaders-but-no-anointed-heir-yet | The article says Xi had not anointed an heir and was instead grooming loyal cadres. That is direct evidence against an orderly, rule-bound succession plan. | 4B.8 |
| Strong negative | **China's choreographed political meet carries message of control** | Reuters | 2024-03-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/chinas-choreographed-political-meet-carries-message-of-control-3331753 | Reuters characterized the 2024 NPC as sending a message of more control for Xi and a deeper focus on national security. This supports a reading of continued personalization rather than constitutional handoff. | 4B.8, 4B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Xi respected term limits, named a successor, or accepted a genuine constitutional transfer constraint.
- The closest affirmative material is procedural NPC formality, which is not the same thing as succession restraint.
